brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A green tea from the Dafengding range in Mabian county, Leshan, Sichuan, made from wild small-leaf plants at around 1500 metres in a national nature reserve.

Treat it as you would any green tea: cooler water, short steeps, and a seller who can say where and when it was picked.
history: It drew praise at the tea section of the Shanghai Expo in May 2010, along with orders worth more than 4.5 million yuan. Little else is documented about its history.
processing: Fixed by microwave, then fired over charcoal by hand.
harvest_season: Before Qingming; one bud with one just-opening leaf.
appearance_dry: Curled and weighty, dark green and glossy with visible down.
appearance_wet: Usually soft green leaf that opens up in the water.
taste_profile: Clean and crisp, with a natural orchid note.
vintage_note: Green teas like this are normally sold as the current year's harvest and are best within a year of picking. It is not an ageing tea.
